newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Philips Q1 N. America sales decline.
newsitem.headline: Philips Q1 N. America sales decline.

text.p: Sales in the U.S. and Canada fell two percent year-on-year in the first 1997 quarter, while sales growth in Asia Pacific slowed to five percent, Philips said on Wednesday.
Sales in other geographical areas were up.
The company earlier announced first-quarter ordinary net up at 460 million guilders from a year-earlier 377 million.

Latin American sales grew 11 percent to 1.15 billion guilders, while African sales grew seven percent to 129 million guilders. All the figures are adjusted for the effects of changes in consolidations and exchange rate movements.
Sales in the Asia Pacific region amounted to 3.47 billion guilders in the first quarter of 1997, while those in the U.S. and Canada were down to 3.32 billion guilders.
Overall European sales growth was modest, except for eastern Europe, Philips said.
Total European sales amounted to 8.07 billion guilders, four percent higher than the year-ago period, Philips said.
The deconsolidation of Grundig contributed to the improvement of European operating income, Philips said. -- Amsterdam newsroom +31 20 504 5000, Fax +31 20 504 5040
